item: Page and document fetches read robots.txt; every guarded session classified; two buttons ask consent
key_paths: src/safety/fetcher.py src/services/duckduckgo.py src/ingest/ipcc_spm.py src/api/source_management.py src/static/app-agenda.js src/static/app-markets.js docs/SECURITY.md tests/test_page_fetching_sessions_read_robots.py tests/test_consent_coverage.py
summary: The DuckDuckGo topic search (a page for people) and the IPCC report PDFs (documents on a website) went out through guarded sessions, which never read robots.txt, though SECURITY.md exempts only published APIs and data files. Both now read it first through the ethical fetcher held to their own host (require_robots_allow), fail closed; a refused search answers refused_by_robots, never 0 sources. A ratchet classifies every src module that builds a guarded session as an API/data-file exemption with its SECURITY.md row, or a robots reader. Agenda feed Verify/Import and the Markets rule Test now pass ensureOnline; their routes keep the named offline refusal. SECURITY.md rows say which transport each lane uses.
